page.title: Batches
page.description: Run large sets of requests offline at the batch service level: upload a JSONL file, follow the progress and download the results

action.cancelBody: Requests that have not started will not run. Requests already in flight may finish for up to 2 minutes before the batch is cancelled.

empty.all: No batches yet. Create one by uploading a JSONL file of requests.
empty.filtered: No batch matches the selected status.

detail.title: Batch {{id}}
detail.pendingHint: Requests the platform is retrying, for example while a deployment wakes, after a preemption by a higher service level, or after a 429 or 5xx answer, are counted as not finished.

download.hint: Output and error files are deleted {{days}} days after the batch ends.
download.expired: This file has expired and was deleted.

detail.cancelPending: Cancel requested. The batch stays cancelling until the requests in flight end, up to 2 minutes.

create.title: Create batch
create.fileHelp: Choose a .jsonl, .json or .txt file with one request per line.

hint.format: JSON Lines, at most {{size}} MB and {{requests, number}} requests.
hint.unique: custom_id must be unique within the file.
hint.sameUrl: All lines use the same url, and it must equal the endpoint you choose.
hint.window: The completion window is 24 hours: a batch that has not finished by then expires.

create.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{limit}} MB.

errors.fileLine: Line {{line}} of the file is not valid: {{reason}}

fileReasons.invalid_json_line: the line is not valid JSON
fileReasons.invalid_url: url is missing or not a supported endpoint
fileReasons.streaming_not_supported: streaming is not supported in a batch
fileReasons.too_many_requests: the file has more requests than a batch allows
fileReasons.upload_failed: the upload could not be read

requestReasons.endpoint_mismatch: the requests in the file do not all use the chosen endpoint
requestReasons.invalid_multipart: the upload is not a valid form

errors.requestInvalid: The batch request is not valid ({{field}}): {{reason}}
